label: Channel cache (Sync Gateway)
type: an in-memory, Enterprise-Edition-tunable cache of channel-to-document routing, growing unbounded with the total number of channels ever created (not just currently active ones) per running sgw:sync-gateway-instance. Deleted/expired tombstones are NOT automatically ejected from it - the compact operation is what removes purged tombstones from the cache.
note: Sibling of sgw:revision-cache; the two caches are tuned via similarly-shaped settings and both interact with tombstone volume, but no page states a relationship between the caches themselves, so they are kept as separate concepts.
